verdict.rationale: Signifyd is a SaaS fraud-protection platform, so an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only a REST API, webhooks, mobile SDKs and a markdown docs endpoint, with no mention of an MCP server or agent connector. Those are developer building blocks, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
